item.description: Samuel J. item.title: Shenandoah Valley Holds Off Tri-Valley for Schuylkill League Division 2 Win
item.description: Shenandoah Valley picked up a hard-fought Schuylkill League Division 2 road win on Monday night, holding off Tri-Valley, 39–37, in a tightly contested girls basketball matchup. Entering the game, Shenandoah Valley stood at 4–5 in league play, while Tri-Valley was looking to build momentum at 2–7. The contest lived up to its billing, with neither team able to pull away as the game came down to the final minutes. Shenandoah Valley used a balanced scoring effort to secure the victory.
